facts.text: Liberty University requires attendance at Convocation for all on-campus, residential students.

sources.title: Convocation FAQ | LU Stages - Liberty University

facts.text: All residential undergraduate students must complete one Christian Community Service (CSER) credit for each full-time semester, up to eight semesters.

sources.title: CSER FAQs | LU Serve - Liberty University

facts.text: All undergraduate and graduate students living on campus are required to attend Convocation on Wednesdays and Fridays.

sources.title: Convocation FAQ | LU Stages | Liberty University
